scope: Exploratory fixed grid on exposed terminal-24k development cases, provided-pancreas region. No deployment or independent test claim.
hypothesis: Trim low-margin voxels far from their own confident lesion core. A small direct-neighbor shell can recover weak boundary tissue without admitting separate blobs.
core: The original -0.5 lesion-winning voxels in each incumbent retained component. Distance uses the full native affine; trim references only the core in that same component.
trim_tiers: Tier 2 is +0.5-only relative to zero bias; tier 3 wins at zero but not at -0.5. Never remove tier 4 or 5.
growth: Only direct 26-neighbors of a retained core within the specified physical radius that win as lesion at +1 but not +0.5, and have background fallback. No pancreas label can change. Zero disables growth.
gate: Beat the exact incumbent positive-case macro Dice; no decline in macro or small-case recall or pooled true positives; retain all incumbent case and component hits; do not increase empty-scan alarms, or false-positive physical volume on positive scans, empty scans, or overall. Report case-level recall regressions separately.
read_scope: Saved independently verified prediction codes and admitted development lesion labels only. No CT reads, GPU, training, or protected test data.
